title: Volume Law and Universality of Entanglement Entropy in Random Graph Fermi Systems
summary: We study the ground-state entanglement entropy of free fermions on random graphs. We first establish a general criterion for the volume law on random graphs, based on the spectral characteristics of the Hamiltonian. We then apply this criterion to the Erdős--Rényi random graph, where each of the possible edges is present independently with some probability.
